purpose: Priority-8/7 curation: domestic and regional counter-institutions, while leaving generic treaties/processes and police labels outside the identity graph.
identityRule: Promote stable courts/commissions/ombudsman bodies clearly identified by dossier context. Generic Court anaphora may resolve only where surrounding text uniquely fixes the court; treaties and review processes remain non-actors.
explicitDeferrals: Generic Court possessives without a uniquely fixed referent remain deferred.
Norway NPM remains a preventive-mechanism function label rather than a separate institution identity.
explicitNonGoals: Do not materialize OPCAT/UPR/FPIC as Actors.
Do not turn legal conventions into institutions.
Do not infer control from an external human-rights institution's assessment.
